title: Backlog — Roadmap
description: Step-4 backlog index: the project's epics, each with its dependency-ordered list of ticket ids. Points at the spec it was sliced from. The ticket detail lives in tickets/<ID>.json.

spec.description: Relative path to the /spec epic plan this backlog was sliced from.

epics.description: The epics in this project. Usually one per validating loop at MVP.

goal.description: One-sentence epic goal — an outcome, not a task.

riskiest_assumption.description: The one thing most likely to be wrong that would kill or reshape the epic. Named at roadmap-time, de-risked in /spec, promoted to an enabler ticket at backlog.

depends_on.description: Epic ids that must land before this one.

tickets.description: Ticket ids in dependency order (enablers first, then stories). Empty when roadmap scaffolds the epic; filled by the backlog skill. Each must have a matching tickets/<ID>.json.

_note.description: Free-text note on slicing rationale or ordering.
